subject: cloud
name: 云朵
label: 三朵弧线的小云
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt: Create ONE standalone drawing of ONE single small CLOUD on a SQUARE 1024x1024 PURE WHITE canvas. Only a cloud: one soft puffy silhouette consisting of four rounded lobes above one shallow curving base. No face. Extremely simple beginner children's coloring picture, black ink contour ONLY, completely empty white interior. Absolutely NO animals, elephants, teddy bears, humans, trees, sun, rain, plants, scenery, ground, words, patterns, shading or gray fills. The cloud is the ONLY object, centered with at least 15% white margin around it. Original elegant picture-book silhouette, organic friendly curves. Do not add any other object.
